central_discriminant: Removal of a phenotype inducer is not equivalent to withdrawal of manual transfers, sorting, scheduling, selective replacement, and controlled habitat.

sources.evidence_grade: E2 main text Methods Results Discussion
sources.rights: CC BY 4.0 main article; third-party exceptions, supplements not audited
sources.evolutionary_replications: five shaken and five resting independently propagated selection lines
interventions: progressive reduction of salt from 6% to 3%
sources.evidence_positive: 4/5 shaken and 4/5 resting endpoint isolates formed macroscopic clusters in habitual-salinity assay without prior inducer
sources.negative_evidence: S3 and R4 did not achieve habitual-salinity clustering; Serratia marcescens tested as species comparator showed no inducible clustering
limitations: genetic assimilation of clustering is not proof of collective self-reproduction
both clonal retention and cellular aggregation contribute to clustering
no unassisted serial daughter-collective establishment measured
raw genome and supplementary data not independently reanalyzed

sources.evidence_grade: E2 full 12-page main text plus figure/methods review
sources.rights: CC BY 4.0 main article; supplementary media and colgen code not copied
sources.parent_ancestry: one previously selected line 17, compared with an isogenic mutS revertant; dependent on earlier same-program Hammerschmidt study
sources.evolutionary_replications: four treatments (two genotypes x two microcosm sizes); 48 microcosm cultures per treatment, 6 blocks x 8, for 10 artificially managed cycles
interventions: manual transfer of smooth morph to fresh vials
manual choice of WS founder for next cycle
replacement of extinct lineages from surviving competitor cultures
investigator controlled culture phase durations and niche
sources.evidence_positive: switch-positive genotypes more reliably completed engineered soma/germ sequence; mutL-linked switching evolved in challenged switch-off group
sources.negative_evidence: first-cycle large vs standard mat failures 40/96 versus 3/96; standard lcs+ net fitness trend decreased; endpoint large lcs- lineages descend from just one ancestor
limitations: large versus standard counts are events not independent origins
rescue/replacement is imposed by researchers, not autonomous natural recolonization
mutation restoration is functional switching not de novo origin of independent multicellular organism
fitness measured under engineered life-cycle scaffold
no published custodian reproduction of sequencing or Bayesian colgen analysis

study_independence: Distinct taxa, laboratories and experimental designs; not replications of the same unassisted closure test. The 2025 study depends on a previous founder from its own research program.

future_only_hypotheses.focus: inducer withdrawal vs unassisted daughter collective establishment
endogenous switching vs investigator-controlled transfer and replacement
ecological context and survival benefit reversals
